cause.watcher_behavior: The resource guard sleeps for the watch interval, then samples and writes health. Its own sampling work can therefore leave the previous valid event older than one interval before the next healthy event appears.
cause.conclusion: The strict native action check correctly refused an aged admission event during this cadence gap. The journal later recorded healthy resources and no unsafe event, then the child exited at 10:23:35.984Z. The receipt cannot establish native acceptance.

repair: At native Scrape action boundaries, wait at most one existing policy watch interval for fresh current-run health. Re-run the unchanged strict owner, stop, unsafe, and freshness checks after each wait. Refuse immediately for every non-stale reason and refuse stale health when the wait expires. The resource policy floors and watchdog stop behavior are unchanged.

verification.red: The file-backed boundary test failed with stale_health at the action wrapper when the latest event aged past 15 seconds before a simulated watcher refresh.
verification.green: node --test tests/browser/native-resource-boundary.test.mjs passes; an action starts only after a new healthy event, while an expired wait and an unsafe event refuse.
verification.mutation: A planted constant-healthy return in the wait path failed the boundary test because the action began without awaiting the refresh; the plant tool restored the original source.

still_needed: Independent review, then a fresh guarded hosted native guest run on the exact development artifact. Its current-run journal must show admitted resources and fresh health at each UI action boundary, with no unsafe or stop event; the native receipt must contain actual guest Scrape cases, geometry, content, and reload observations before acceptance.
